_comment: Override only what the brand actually changes. Re-run new_project.py --force, or just regenerate assets/brand.css from this. --brand was #B05F0F until 11 Sep 2026, when axe-core measured it at 4.27:1 on --brand-wash and the template corrected it to #A5590E.
